result:
Looking at the qlang documentation and the tasks, I'll write each query step by step.

Key concepts I'm using:
- `filter ~(...)` to filter vectors
- `groupBy ~(...)` to group elements
- `* ...` to map over elements
- `coalesce` for default values
- `:name /` to bind values to names for later reference
- `!|` for error handling
- Various verbs like `sum`, `count`, `sort`, `entries`, `distinct`, etc.

O1: Sum totals of "paid" orders (case-insensitive), null/missing = 0
O2: Count orders per region, excluding "cancelled" (case-insensitive)
O3: Filter open issues with "bug" label (case-insensitive), sort by comments desc then number asc, take 3
O4: Collect distinct assignee logins, lowercase and deduplicate, sort
O5: Packages from dependencies + devDependencies starting with "^", sort
O6: Users from Berlin (case-insensitive), return {id, name, email}
O7: Services that are enabled (true or missing) and have a port, map name to port
O8: Average duration_ms for "click" type items (case-sensitive), round to 2 decimals
O9: Count requests per path, top 2 by count descending, ties by path ascending
O10: Average salary per dept (CSV parsing), round to 1 decimal
O11: Exact version packages from requirements.txt (==), lowercase names, join with comma
O12: Sum numbers per name (case-insensitive), return as object
O13: Sum qty per sku across all orders, top 3 by qty descending, ties by sku ascending
O14: Boolean: true if all closed issues have non-null assignee

O1: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * (at :total | coalesce 0) | sum
O2: filter ~(/status | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/region) | * count
O3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels * (lower | eq "bug") | any) | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * /number
O4: * (at :assignee) | filter ~(ne null) | * /login | * lower | distinct | sort
O5: [(/dependencies | entries) (/devDependencies | entries)] | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * (/0 | keyword) | sort
O6: filter ~(/address/city | lower | eq "berlin" !| false) | * {:id /id :name /name :email (at :email)}
O7: /services | filter ~(/enabled | coalesce true) | filter ~(has :port) | indexBy ~/name | * /port
O8: /data/items | filter ~(/type | eq "click") | * (at :duration_ms) | filter ~(ne null) | :values / | sum | div (/values | count) | round 2
O9: split "\n" | filter ~(ne "") | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) | * count | entries | * {:path /0 :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /path]) | take 2
O10: split "\n" | drop 1 | * (:row (split ",") | :dept (/row | /1) | :salary (/row | /2) | {:dept /dept :salary (if (/salary | eq "") ~(null) ~(/salary | parseJson))}) | filter ~(/salary | ne null) | groupBy ~/dept | * (* /salary | :values / | :sum (/values | sum) | :count (/values | count) | /sum | div /count | round 1)
O11: split "\n" | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==" | /0 | lower) | sort | join ","
O12: split ", " | * ((split ":") | :name (/0 | lower) | :value (/1 | parseJson) | {:name /name :value /value}) | groupBy ~/name | * (* /value | sum)
O13: * /items | flat | groupBy ~/sku | * (* /qty | sum) | entries | * {:sku /0 :qty /1} | sort ~([(/qty | desc) /sku]) | take 3
O14: filter ~(/state | eq "closed") | every ~(/assignee | ne null)
